g.text: OOAPI Reference Implementation - Public API Resource Model
Generated from src/OEAPI.Core/Models/ApiModels/*.cs. Shows identifying fields (id, primaryCode,
name, the resource's own "type"/"state" discriminator where one exists) and the fields that
define a relationship arrow - not a full property dump. Every relationship pictured is a spec
"*Id" + expandable-object field pair (e.g. organisationId / organisation), unless noted
otherwise. Regenerate via docs/diagrams/render.ps1 or render.sh after changing the source .cs
files. See docs/archive/DECISIONS-AND-ACTIONS.md for the extensible-enum fields shown here as
plain strings (organisationType, roomType, state, role, etc.) - all validated via
[ExtensibleEnum], not C# enums. A symmetric parent/child self-reference (e.g. Organisation's
parent/parentId + children/childIds) is drawn once, as a single arrow from the "parent"
perspective - the inverse childIds/children field pair exists in code but isn't given its own
themselves expose (minus the id and validFrom/validTo fields) - a full,
independent alternate snapshot, not a diff against the parent resource.
